purpose: Teach: あらわす/すすめる/雇う/建つ/散る/知ろ/ずばり/いちど

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、絵で感情あらわすの上手いよな
lines.en: Riku, you're actually really good at expressing feelings through your drawings.
lines.style: Light, genuine compliment. Warm recognition. Not forced — like she's noticing something real and letting him know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、俺にこの参考書をすすめるなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't try to recommend me reference books, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, deflecting. Slight wry edge on the opening — he's catching her mid-scheme. Quick, defensive. Keeps distance with humor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、家事に手伝いを雇うのか?
lines.en: Wait — does your family actually hire help for housework?
lines.style: Curious, testing. Shift in topic — she's poking at something. Eyebrow-raise tone. Not unkind, just direct observation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家の隣、新しいビルが建つらしいぞ、桜
lines.en: They're building a new building next to your place, apparently.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact deflection. He's changing the subject. Quiet certainty — like he knows something she doesn't. Slight pause-weight on the information.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、桜が散る前にお花見しようぜ
lines.en: Come on, let's go see the cherry blossoms before they all fall.
lines.style: Inviting, direct. She's proposing something she wants them to do together. Light energy — not asking permission, suggesting a plan.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、もっと自分を知ろうとしろよ、桜
lines.en: You should try to understand yourself better, Sakura.
lines.style: Serious underneath the casual delivery. He means this. Slight weight on the opening — this isn't a joke. Steady gaze. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ずばり言って、好きな子いるんだろ?
lines.en: Riku — be honest. There's someone you like, right?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a sharp edge underneath. She's calling him out. Direct, testing — leaning in like she's caught him in something. Slight teasing lilt.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、いちど真面目に勉強してみろよ、桜
lines.en: Try actually studying seriously for once, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet frustration. He's giving advice he knows she won't take. Slight edge — care wrapped in exasperation. Almost paternal. Not harsh, just tired.
